transforms.operation: Assign the stable per-unit MFM option ordinal after resolving the datasheet to its repository unit id.

filters: Keep only datasheets matched to an existing repository unit.
precedence: Preserve options for dump-absent units; replace options for each matched unit.
/id.reason: MFM has no core-option identity; the writer creates a deterministic repository id from the matched unit and derived option order.

transforms.operation: Resolve the owning datasheet display name to an existing repository unit id.

filters: Exclude Legends datasheets and require a matched repository unit.
precedence: The first candidate repository directory containing the unit wins.
/unit_id.reason: Options are emitted only for the repository unit matched from the choice set owner datasheet.

transforms.operation: Route publication-owned datasheets to the repository faction directory.

filters: Use the repository directory selected for the matched unit.
precedence: Publication ownership is evaluated before shared-roster fallback.
/faction_id.reason: The writer scopes each rebuilt option to the directory selected from the datasheet publication owner.

transforms.operation: Derive the option model constraint from its miniature scope, limited-set ratio, and optional-swap input type.

filters: Use only defaultValue-zero wargear options as optional swaps.
Only mini-scoped single-item limited sets create per-option ratio bounds.
precedence: A mini-scoped wargear_limit ratio binds before checkbox max_count; otherwise emit any_number.
/model_constraint.reason: The projection implements the supported ratio and checkbox paths but deliberately leaves shared, flat, datasheet-wide, duplicate, mandatory, alternate, and all-model semantics outside an option constraint.

transforms.operation: Emit the localized miniature name only for a miniature-scoped option on a multi-model datasheet.

filters: Omit for datasheet-wide sets and single-model datasheets.
/model_constraint/model_name.reason: The model constraint uses the MFM miniature scope when a distinct repository model label is needed.

transforms.operation: Select the tightest positive choiceLimit/modelCount ratio and convert it to a per-model interval.

filters: Require a miniature-scoped limited set containing exactly one resolved item.
Ignore zero model counts and non-positive limits.
precedence: The smallest positive ratio for an added item wins.
/model_constraint/per_n_models.reason: Only mini-scoped single-item ratio limits are represented on individual options; other limited-set caps become unit budgets or remain unsupported here.

transforms.operation: Set a unit-wide cap of one when every granted optional-swap item is offered only through checkbox controls.

filters: Inspect only defaultValue-zero, miniature-scoped swap options.
precedence: Do not emit this cap when a mini-scoped wargear_limit ratio applies.
/model_constraint/max_count.reason: Checkbox-only swaps are represented as one-instance caps; duplicateLimit is not consumed.

transforms.operation: Use any_number as the fallback after ratio and checkbox cap checks.

filters: Inspect only derived optional swap deltas.
precedence: Fallback after mini-scoped ratio and checkbox-only caps.
/model_constraint/any_number.reason: The fallback represents the currently supported per-model swap path; shared limits are enforced separately as unit budgets.

transforms.operation: Resolve choice item names and take each branch multiset delta against the scoped base loadout.

filters: Drop branches emptied by unresolved items and no-op deltas.
precedence: Use a clean option-group default first; fall back to base_miniature_loadout when it cannot supply a uniform base.
/replaces.reason: Replacement removals are derived deltas, not direct MFM fields, and are partial when item names cannot resolve to repository ids.

transforms.operation: Resolve a base-loadout item and retain it only when absent from the selected branch.

filters: Omit unresolved items and no-op deltas.
precedence: Use the reviewed base-loadout fallback after an unusable option-group base.
/replaces/*.reason: Each removal is a resolved repository item id produced by branch differencing.

transforms.operation: Resolve a single grouped added branch into replacement ids, repeating each item by its count.

filters: Emit only when exactly one nonempty added branch remains after resolution and deduplication.
/replacement.reason: A single derived branch becomes replacement; unresolved names leave the graph partially projected.

transforms.operation: Resolve each added item name to a repository id and preserve its positive multiplicity.

/replacement/*.reason: Each replacement element is a resolved item from the supported loadout choice graph.

transforms.operation: Group distinct added branches sharing the same removed multiset into replacement_choice.

filters: Emit only when more than one nonempty added branch remains.
/replacement_choice.reason: Alternative replacement branches are derived from the supported ordinary loadout choice graph.

transforms.operation: Emit one resolved added-item branch for each distinct delta.

/replacement_choice/*.reason: Each choice branch is a resolved ordinary-choice delta.

transforms.operation: Resolve one item occurrence in a grouped added branch.

/replacement_choice/*/*.reason: Each nested element is a resolved repository item id.
